author: Jones et al.
mechanism_rationale: TST sequentiality identified as dominant mechanism: high-frequency goal-directed behavior generates feedback across episodes. Cybernetic difference equation directly formalizes the feedback loop I(t+1) ← I(t) + GA(t).
jitai_who: Posterior non-corrector probability P(β_fail > −0.01 | data) as continuous targeting score
jitai_when: Goal-attainment failure windows (GA below person mean)
notes: Person-level β_fail heterogeneity (SD = 0.091) as precision targeting basis. Cross-architecture comparison vs. dual-process logistic. Seed entry — verified against published paper.

author: Jones & Schüz
mechanism_rationale: TST synchronicity identified as dominant mechanism: established daily smokers show strong within-episode cue competition. Dual-process logistic formalizes the habitual (cue/urge) vs. reflective (intention) pathway competition.
jitai_who: CPD below median (lighter smokers show stronger cue effects)
jitai_when: High social cue + high urge + low intention windows (~6.8% of assessments)
notes: CPD moderates cue dependence (w3 = −0.127). TST interplay term (Cues × Intention) significant. Seed entry — verified against published paper.
